result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, traffic signals, and marked crosswalks within a mixed-use urban environment. However, safety is significantly compromised by a large truck obstructing sightlines and faded pavement markings that reduce the visibility of the crossing area.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white box truck is parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.

hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their effectiveness in alerting drivers to the pedestrian crossing zone.
